about: Append-only parts of the records, written by python scripts/kb.py index: outcomes from CHEPTA runs, informed_by lists, corrections (keys.corrects with keys.correction_reason) and the ids of the indexed rows. Editing or deleting one in dataset/records/, or adding keys.corrects to an indexed row, fails the checks: add a new row or entry instead. Changing this file by hand is a deliberate correction; say why in the commit.
